flight.duration_h.source: docs/SPEC.md §1 Flight duration ≥ 4 h (brief ~4 hour flight)

power.pack_chemistry.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.1 Energizer L91 Ultimate Lithium AA; forbidden alkaline and LiPo 1S

power.series_cells.source: docs/SPEC.md §2 fixed three-cell LightHAB power architecture

power.mean_flight_current_mA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.2 ASSUMED average pack current ≤ 200 mA mean over 4 h (GPS on + ESP32 + OpenLog + APRS/WSPR TX duty)

power.flight_energy_mAh.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.2 usable fixed-3s capacity must be ≥1600 mAh under the actual cold/load profile while four-hour demand remains ≤800 mAh

power.switch_off_current_uA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.3 Switch OFF pack current: 0 µA except holder/switch leakage; switch must break the pack positive

power.cutdown_off_leakage_uA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.3 Cutdown MOSFET/relay OFF leakage ≤ 50 µA at max pack voltage

power.led_off_leakage_uA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.3 Write LED OFF leakage ≤ 1 µA (no bleed path that looks like a glow)

power.gpio_logic_V.source: docs/SPEC.md §2 LightHAB J2.3 supplies the carrier 3V3 rail

openlog.vcc_V.value: direct LightHAB J2.3 3V3; host rail capacity accepted by user and pending bench validation
openlog.vcc_V.source: docs/SPEC.md §2; SparkFun OpenLog supports 3.3–12 V and recommends 3.3–5 V

antenna.connector.source: docs/SPEC.md §3 Two SMA jacks facing downward through the payload; 50 Ω; APRS and WSPR

cutdown.load_current_A.source: docs/SPEC.md §5 Cutdown current ASSUMED ≤ 2 A burst for ≤ 30 s; FET/relay and trace must carry this

power.strap_leakage_uA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.3 Pull-ups/downs on host GPIOs: extra leakage through straps ≤ 50 µA total; check MCU strapping table before any pin

antenna.keepout_mm.source: docs/SPEC.md §3 Keepout: ASSUMED ≥ 5 mm board keepout from SMA dielectric; no battery metal in the near-field of the jacks

host.free_gpio.value: J2.1 A1/PB08 is one-way OpenLog UART_TX through R4; J2.2 A2/PB09 is active-low LED_N with R2 reset pull-up; J2.5-J2.9 are unused carrier contacts

firmware.openlog_baud.value: 9600 baud scaffold default; verify against the installed OpenLog configuration before flight

power.openlog_idle_mA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.3 approved OpenLog idle qualification limit

mechanical.lighthab_module_zone.value: provisional 56 x 75 mm zone at x=134..190, y=95..170 with H1-H4 and J2/J3 explicitly awaiting measurement; all carrier component bodies remain in the left wing
mechanical.lighthab_module_zone.source: docs/SPEC.md §5 and docs/LAYOUT.md provisional LightHAB carrier geometry

power.board_added_active_peak_mA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.3 approved logger active/write peak budget

power.openlog_write_mA.source: docs/SPEC.md §2.3 approved OpenLog write-current qualification limit

power.split_architecture.value: LightHAB J2.3 3V3 directly powers OpenLog A1 VCC, C1/C2 bypass, and the activity LED path; OUT1/GND passes independently through J3 to J5
